# betterado_repository_policy_max_file_size (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_git_repository" "example" {
  name       = "ExampleRepo"
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
}

resource "betterado_repository_policy_max_file_size" "example" {
  project_id     = data.betterado_project.example.id
  enabled        = true
  blocking       = true
  repository_ids = [data.betterado_git_repository.example.id]
  max_file_size  = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `max_file_size` (Number)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `blocking` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `repository_ids` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
